title: Stoker metadata — achievements
description: `games/<id>/achievements.json`: the definitions a game's achievements are kept against, in the game's own order. Definitions only — whose unlocks those are is a Stoker instance's, and never leaves it. A game's DLC have no list of their own: the stores keep a DLC's achievements in its game's.

ubisoftList.description: Ubisoft Connect's achievement list for the game, as Ubisoft gives it — what `aliases` are mapped from. Kept because Ubisoft only gives it to an account that owns the game. Not achievements of their own: a Steam edition already has Steam's.

apiName.description: The achievement's identity: what the game grants it by, and what every unlock is keyed by. For GOG, `achievement_key` — not the numeric id.

aliases.description: Other names the game grants this same achievement under — as another store's API names it. Watch_Dogs on Steam grants through Ubisoft's API by number, which Stoker's loader reports as `uplay_<n>`; listing `uplay_1` here makes that grant this achievement. A name belongs to one achievement of a game, and is never also an `apiName`.

hidden.description: Not described to a player until unlocked.

iconLocked.description: The store's own locked icon. Steam ships a separate grey one, and a greyscale filter over the colour icon does not look like it.
